description.sr:
Napiši tip `DeepReadonly<T>` koji svako svojstvo objekta, uključujući ugnježdene objekte, pravi `readonly`.

Funkcije ostaju kakve jesu, a primitivni tipovi se ne menjaju.

Primer:
```ts
type X = { a: number; b: { c: string } };
type R = DeepReadonly<X>; // { readonly a: number; readonly b: { readonly c: string } }
```

Ne izvršava se nikakav kod: rešenje je tačno kad nema grešaka tipova.
description.en:
Write a type `DeepReadonly<T>` that makes every property of an object `readonly`, including nested objects.

Functions stay as they are, and primitive types are not changed.

Example:
```ts
type X = { a: number; b: { c: string } };
type R = DeepReadonly<X>; // { readonly a: number; readonly b: { readonly c: string } }
```

No code is executed: the solution is correct when there are no type errors.

hiddenTests: type Case3 = Expect<Equal<DeepReadonly<{ f: () => void }>['f'], () => void>>;

note.sr: Funkcije se moraju izuzeti pre provere `extends object`, jer su i one objekti, pa bi mapiranje preko njih dalo `{}`.
note.en: Functions must be excluded before the `extends object` check, because they are objects too and mapping over them would give `{}`.
